entry_points.text: Filter suite driver walks full catalog with rescheduling and range exclusion, runs fill helpers before creation, frees helper memory after, tracks pass, fail and JIT counts, logs per-test status and fails if any case failed; segmentation driver walks builder and feature table, builds, segments, frees and summarizes.

Module initialization validates suite selector against three labels, defaults to base suite when selective filters exist without suite, narrows range, runs selected suites in fixed order and releases tail-call resources; exit hook performs no action.

Firmware exposes sysfs for config, reset, sync, platform, async, custom fallback, batched sync and async, register, unregister, release-all and page-limited readback; misc read copies loaded firmware under lock; init allocates config and registers device with unwind on failure and exit releases firmware, unregisters, destroys uploads and frees config.

Debug-virtual init translates fixed vmalloc address and fresh object to physical with logging and clean failure, exit releases object; dynamic-debug init and exit emit messages with parameter set and get invoking shared print; FPU glue wraps check with acquire and release and debugfs file triggers check; free-pages stress loops allocate, reference, free and drop under two flag sets.

exports.text: BPF test helper formats fixed locals plus one 64-bit argument into small scratch buffer and returns length; helper identifier is bound to the maximum function identifier.
Batched async trigger store and floating-point check have external linkage for use from other objects in the test build.

hazards.text: Allocation failures avoid leaking companions: fixture builders free built packet or page, data-generation failure aborts subtest loop with error count and creation failure skips execution while releasing helper memory.

Relocation mutates immediates in place with unreachable call sites replaced by neutral skip, missing and invalid targets encoded as distinct indices at and beyond table end and repetition-limit outcome derived from configured maximum plus one times run count.

Async trigger waits for completion while holding global mutex and frees duplicated name after submit so callback and name use must avoid that mutex and copy; small shows read unlocked config, upload selection borrows list-owned name and platform trigger mutates global list and flag without visible lock.

Batched loops use eight-bit index bounding request count with truncation risk; firmware and upload readback reject images over one page; null async image is treated as missing file without detail; batch callback sleep and cancel polling block for seconds to minutes.
Batched release assumes count matches array length and frees optional buffers before firmware entries then array; null worker argument records invalid-argument outcome and terminates with error.

invariants.text: Ordered catalog covers long jumps for runtime taken versus not taken and JIT-known always versus never outcomes, plus staggered jumps over unconditional and equality, inequality, bit-test, unsigned and signed comparisons across wide and narrow immediate and register encodings with shared run count.

Packet inputs are built from static dummy device and caller buffer with oversize rejection, max-size allocation, prefix copy and link, protocol, queue, mark, hash, vlan, device and header setup; generation yields no data, heap memory, or packet with optional paged fragment and release mirrors that dispatch.

Filter extent prefers helper length and pointer when present else scans static instruction array backward for last nonzero entry; classic type builds via program creator with expected-failure comparison while internal type allocates, copies, records stack depth and zero-extension intent and selects runtime.

Timed runs stamp monotonic time around fixed iteration loop and normalize per run with clamped count, iterating subtests until zero size and result terminator with per-subtest data and mismatch counting; selection prefers single id then name scan then interval with errors for bad id, unknown name or inverted range.

Tail-call table runs from leaf arithmetic through chained accumulation and stack load and store with frame sizing to repetition-limit, missing-target and invalid-index errors; preparation allocates table plus spare slot, measures double-slot operations, copies, rewrites placeholders and selectors, resolves helpers and selects runtime, releasing all on failure.

Request count, buffer size and offset are immutable while batched array exists; boolean, size and small-integer stores return full write length on success and shows emit single decimal plus newline; upload lookup uses bounded prefix match with borrowed name and sync-direct flag switches loader routine.

Uploads live on global list with name, buffer and handle where removal unlinks, unregisters and frees and clears selected name; payloads with inject marker select progress stage and error name by prefix match for later stage handlers.

Hexdump uses fixed 32-byte vector with ASCII mirror and precomputed groupings for widths one, two, four and eight in both orders honoring host endianness; builder clamps rows, validates power-of-two group size and emits groups with padded ASCII; floating-point check needs three derived comparisons above base.

Packet management, monotonic timing, slab and page allocation, firmware loading, thread launch, completions, debugfs, delays and page reference helpers from other dossiers are relied upon and not specified here.

locks.text: Timed execution holds migration disabled across timestamp capture and full run loop, releasing only after final timestamp so measured iterations do not migrate.

Single global mutex serializes config, reset, sync, async and platform triggers, batched starts, upload register and unregister, readback and teardown; double-underscore helpers require caller-held mutex while wrappers lock internally.

Spin family pairs lock with guarded counter and pointer across plain, interrupt-masked, bottom-half-masked and flag-saving variants with paired release, try-acquire guards and scoped sections; mutex, seqlock, semaphore, bit-lock, local, RCU and SRCU require acquisition before guarded access.

Per-CPU raw spinlock is addressed by value or pointer accessor with lock then unlock and no inner work; local trylock bumps per-CPU counter only while held; wound-wait covers blocking, interruptible, try and slow paths with acquire context completion and teardown.

state_machines.text: Tail validation follows allocate, populate and relocate, runtime-select, execute, destroy; execution reschedules, skips excluded indices, requires present program, records JIT status, optionally supplies state cell, runs fixed repetitions, optionally reads back from state, compares, tallies and fails on any mismatch.

Configuration moves from uninitialized to initialized with defaults, stays mutable until batched allocation, resets by free plus reinit and frees by releasing requests and clearing name; single slot cycles empty, loading and loaded with release-before-issue and async wait; platform publishes stack image, forces checked flag, validates and restores.

Batched sync moves idle to active on allocation, to thread-running per slot, to completed per waiter and stays active until explicit release with busy rejection; async moves idle, active, submitted and callback-completed with same release rule and setup failure still waiting submitted slots.

Upload moves through prepare validating size and arming injection, repeated bounded writes and poll-complete, with cancel flag observed by all stages and cleanup clearing injection; prepare failure clears itself because cleanup runs only after successful prepare.

structs.text: Segment case pairs label with no-argument packet builder and feature set; tail case pairs label with fixed internal instruction buffer, flag word, expected result, stack depth and tail-call presence marker.

Global config aggregates name, buffer and offset sizes, mode flags, counts, upload name, batched array, result and loader selector; batched record carries index, result, sent flag, firmware, name and buffer pointers, completion, task and device; upload links into list with name, buffer, cancel flag, injected error and handle.

Test control is misc device with dynamic minor, name, file operations and attribute groups; attributes form null-terminated array for reset, knobs, triggers and readback; upload operations bind prepare, write, poll-complete, cancel and cleanup.

Tail-call marker is 0x7a11ca11 with null 0x7fff and invalid 0x7ffe and state flags bit zero need-state and bit one result-in-state; firmware defaults use test-firmware.bin with four requests; hexdump buffer totals 131 bytes.

Dynamic-debug defines ten disjoint values from zero plus short names, version levels and letter levels in distinct ranges; per-model wrapper creates bits word plus class parameter with owner read-write callback.
